steps.subject: Your Franklin Navigator community profile
steps.body:
Hi {{Outreach_Greeting}},

Franklin Navigator is a local community network that helps Franklin residents find and connect with local businesses, professionals, organizations and resources.

We have a Franklin Navigator profile for your business:
View or claim your profile: {{Profile_URL}}

Claiming and managing the basic profile is free. No purchase is required.

If anything is inaccurate, factual corrections and profile-removal requests are always free.

For businesses that want additional profile features, Community Membership is optional at $35/year, renewing annually until canceled. It can add richer business details, services, hours, photos, website and contact links, and booking or quote links where applicable.

Questions? Reply to this email and we’ll be happy to help.

This is a commercial community-outreach email from Franklin Navigator.

notes: Exactly two follow-ups are enabled for the pilot; the prior third follow-up draft is intentionally not enabled to reduce complaint risk.
Follow-ups are never sent after a reply, unsubscribe, bounce, complaint, correction/removal request, organization/domain suppression, or other stop signal.
Mailshake campaign 1553662 remains paused and is not the sending engine.

Owner explicitly authorized the first-10 initial emails to begin outside normal business hours on 2026-09-29. This exception applies only to the initial email; follow-ups stay within Mon-Fri 09:00-16:00 America/Chicago.
Every step BCCs reachrgnow@gmail.com through owner_bcc.
Every message must retain a visible unsubscribe link plus RFC 8058 one-click headers, and open/click tracking remains off.
